message.content:
Based on my search, here's how to log into OneDrive:

## OneDrive Web Login (Browser)

1. **Go to the OneDrive login page**: Visit https://onedrive.live.com/login/ or https://www.onedrive.com

2. **Click "Sign in"**: Look for the sign-in button, usually in the top-right corner

3. **Enter your Microsoft account credentials**:
   - Email address, phone number, or Skype ID
   - Password

4. **Complete any additional security verification** (if MFA is enabled)

5. **Access your OneDrive files** after successful login

---

## OneDrive Desktop App (Windows)

1. **Open OneDrive**: Search for "OneDrive" in the Start Menu or check the system tray/cloud icon in the taskbar

2. **Click the OneDrive icon** and select "Sign in"

3. **Enter your Microsoft Account email** and click **Sign in**

4. **Enter your password** if prompted (if using the same account as Windows, you may not need a password)

5. **Follow the setup prompts**:
   - Review Privacy Policy → Click **Next**
   - Choose data sharing preferences → Click **Accept**
   - Confirm/change your OneDrive folder location → Click **Next**
   - Select folders to back up → Click **Start backup**

---

## OneDrive Mobile App

1. **Download OneDrive** from your device's app store (iOS/Android)

2. **Open the OneDrive app**

3. **Tap Sign in** and enter your Microsoft account credentials

4. **Complete any MFA verification** if required

---

## Important Notes

- **You need a Microsoft account** to use OneDrive. If you don't have one, you can create it at the login page by clicking "Create one" or "Sign up"
- **Work/School accounts**: If your organization uses Microsoft 365, you may need to use your organizational email (e.g., username@company.edu) and go through your organization's login portal
- **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)**: Many accounts now require additional verification via text, authenticator app, or email

---

## Troubleshooting Login Issues

If you can't log in:
- **Reset your password**: Use the "Forgot password?" link
- **Check credentials**: Ensure you're using the correct Microsoft account
- **Clear cached credentials**: Go to Control Panel > User Accounts > Credential Manager > Windows Credentials, find OneDrive credentials and update/remove them
- **Reset OneDrive app**: Run `%localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset` in the Run dialog (Win + R)

Sources:
1. https://td.usnh.edu/TDClient/60/Portal/KB/Article/2064/OneDrive-Accessing-Logging-in-to-OneDrive
2. https://www.bunian.cn/22394.html
3. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
4. https://www.cu.edu/doc/how-log-onedrive-pcpdf-3
5. https://zhidao.baidu.com/question/931669486309366379.html
6. https://www.systoolsgroup.com/updates/copy-onedrive-files-to-another-onedrive-account/
7. https://www.windowsphoneinfo.com/threads/unable-to-login-to-personal-onedrive.913934/
